config.design: Full-minus-leave-one tangent differences give8 gain Jacobian columns at gain1. Fit per-context oracle correction to exact-context output target with relative-effect weighted least squares pooled over3 probes, separate receiver/receiver and donor/donor endpoints. Evaluate withheld fresh2 and actual composed full/half steps. No gain clipping, no adaptive step selection.
config.limitations: Uses target responses per test prompt; not a predictive model. One local Gauss-Newton step, not global optimum of gain family. Linearized residual is only local.
